record.reason: GIFT and GIFT-CC enforce user-data isolation during LLM serving using GPU information-flow tracking and encryption. The primary objective is privacy/security, not inference efficiency. The authors evaluate effects on serving throughput and latency (including up to 4-10.7% throughput overhead in the abstract and optimization-specific overheads), leaving a narrow but direct systems-performance connection; retained as borderline.
record.title: Here is a GIFT: Enforcing User Data Isolation in LLM Serving via GPU Information Flow Tracking
